patterns: tell me about ai and ds department
responses: The Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI & DS) Department focuses on imparting core knowledge in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision to prepare students for cutting-edge industry and research roles.

Typical 3rd Year AI & DS core subjects include:
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Big Data Analytics & Distributed Systems
- Computer Vision / Reinforcement Learning
- Cloud Computing & DevOps for AI
- Mini-Project / Capstone Phase 1.
The 3rd year practical curriculum includes the Machine Learning Lab, Deep Learning & GPU Computing Lab, and the Data Analytics Lab with tools like Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Apache Spark.
The Head of the AI & DS Department is available in the Department Office (Block B, 2nd Floor). You can also reach out to faculty members during their scheduled consultation hours.
For 3rd year students, Mini-Projects should focus on applied ML/DL, Web-AI integrations, or Data Pipelines. Please consult your project coordinator for synopsis submission and review deadlines.
A minimum of 75% attendance is required to be eligible for internal assessments and end-semester university examinations.
